mapper.sql: f.id, f.title, f.content, f.category_id, f.pinned, f.featured, f.like_count, f.author_user, f.author_name, f.reply_count, f.last_reply_time, f.created_time, f.updated_time, fc.name AS category_name, DATE_FORMAT(f.created_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS created_time_text, DATE_FORMAT(f.last_reply_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS last_reply_time_text, EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM forum_like fl WHERE fl.post_id = f.id AND fl.user_id = #{me}) AS liked
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO forum_post (title, content, category_id, author_user, author_name) VALUES (#{title}, #{content}, #{categoryId}, #{authorUser}, #{authorName})
mapper.select:
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM forum_post f
MATCH(f.title, f.content) AGAINST (#{keyword} IN BOOLEAN MODE)
(f.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR f.content LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
AND f.category_id = #{categoryId}
SELECT FROM forum_post f LEFT JOIN forum_category fc ON fc.id = f.category_id WHERE f.id = #{id}
mapper.update: UPDATE forum_post SET pinned = #{pinned} WHERE id = #{id}

mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO forum_like (post_id, user_id) VALUES (#{postId}, #{userId})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM forum_like WHERE post_id = #{postId} AND user_id = #{userId}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM forum_like WHERE post_id = #{postId} AND user_id = #{userId}
mapper.update: UPDATE forum_post SET like_count = like_count + #{delta} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT fl.user_id AS userId, COALESCE(s.name, i.name) AS userName, DATE_FORMAT(fl.created_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS created_time_text FROM forum_like fl LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.user_id = fl.user_id LEFT JOIN student s ON u.ref_id = s.id AND u.user_type = 'STUDENT' LEFT JOIN instructor i ON u.ref_id = i.id AND u.user_type = 'INSTRUCTOR' WHERE fl.post_id = #{postId} ORDER BY fl.created_time ASC LIMIT #{limit}
